name: @rello-platform/vault-crypto
description: Canonical SpokeApiKeyVault encryption for the Rello platform — scrypt KDF + AES-256-GCM, single v2 encoding (authTag last), config-injected secret, keyId versioning, + byte-faithful legacy decoders for the 7-spoke migration (CROSS-REPO-WALK-DECISIONS-260609 Q7 lock)
comment:exports: Single-format ESM on purpose, mirroring @rello-platform/signals: the SAME ESM entry is exposed under require/default. Node >=22.12 require(esm) loads it (no top-level await). All consumers run Node 22 (engines >=22 <23).
